facts.text: The Arrabelle is a ski-in/ski-out resort in Lionshead Village, steps from the Eagle Bahn Gondola with direct access to Vail Mountain.
facts.excerpt: is a premier ski-in/ski-out luxury resort in Lionshead Village, steps from the Eagle Bahn Gondola and direct access to Vail Mountain.

facts.text: The Arrabelle has a plaza with an open-air ice rink in winter, plus year-round shopping, dining and apres-ski just outside the door.
facts.excerpt: The Arrabelle features a vibrant plaza with an open-air ice rink in winter, plus year-round shopping, dining, and après-ski, all just outside your door.

facts.text: The hotel has rooftop hot tubs and a lap pool.
facts.excerpt: Rooftop hot tubs and lap pool

facts.text: The pool is heated year-round.
facts.excerpt: Heated pool (Year-round)

facts.text: The hotel offers a slopeside ski and boot valet and equipment storage service, plus a ski concierge.
facts.excerpt: Slopeside ski and boot valet and equipment storage service

facts.text: The hotel has a RockResorts Spa.
facts.excerpt: The award-winning RockResorts Spa

facts.text: There is a summer amphitheater with featured concerts.
facts.excerpt: Summer amphitheater with featured concerts

facts.text: Guests have access to the Red Sky Golf Club.
facts.excerpt: Exclusive access to the Red Sky Golf Club

facts.text: The property has an ice skating rink and outdoor fire pits.
facts.excerpt: Ice skating rink and outdoor fire pits

facts.text: The hotel is mountain bike-friendly, with bike storage.
facts.excerpt: Mountain bike-friendly hotel

facts.text: The conference center has a 2,600-square-foot Grand Ballroom.
facts.excerpt: The Arrabelle features a conference center with a 2,600 square-foot Grand Ballroom

facts.text: The hotel has a playground.
facts.excerpt: Playground

facts.text: The facade layers creamy stucco with rough-cut stone, arched windows and timber Juliet balconies, with roughly two dozen hand-painted alpine murals.
facts.excerpt: The façade layers creamy stucco with rough-cut stone, arched windows, and timber Juliet balconies, and roughly two dozen delicate, hand-painted alpine murals

facts.text: The hotel sits on Lionshead's main square, and its clock tower rises above the surrounding buildings.
facts.excerpt: its clock tower rises above the surrounding buildings

facts.text: The lobby has high ceilings with exposed wood beams and iron chandeliers, and a large stone fireplace.
facts.excerpt: The room is spacious, with high ceilings punctuated by exposed wood beams and iron chandeliers

facts.text: The Arrabelle opened in 2010 as part of the Vail Square development and was designed to echo the grand alpine hotels of Europe.
facts.excerpt: Opened in 2010 as part of the Vail Square development, The Arrabelle was designed to echo the grand alpine hotels of Europe.

facts.text: The hotel is managed by Vail Resorts under the RockResorts banner.
facts.excerpt: managed by Vail Resorts under the RockResorts banner

facts.text: Hotel rooms have carved-wood headboards, gas fireplaces with hand-painted murals and balconies facing either the Gore Range or Lionshead Square.
facts.excerpt: The hotel rooms follow a consistent design ethos, with carved-wood headboards, gas fireplaces with hand-painted murals, thick drapery, and balconies that face either the Gore Range or Lionshead Square.

facts.text: Private residences range from one to five bedrooms.
facts.excerpt: a collection of private residences that range from one to five bedrooms

facts.text: The residences have full kitchens, dining areas, living rooms with fireplaces and laundry.
facts.excerpt: These spaces also feature full kitchens, dining areas, living rooms with fireplaces, and laundry

facts.text: Each residence has its own decor, with artwork, textiles and furniture that vary.
facts.excerpt: each one has its own décor. Artwork, textiles, and even furniture selections vary

facts.text: Bathrooms are spacious, often with separate soaking tubs and showers.
facts.excerpt: Bathrooms are spacious, often with separate soaking tubs and showers

facts.text: Spa locker rooms include a steam room and a sauna.
facts.excerpt: Locker rooms include a steam room and a sauna

facts.text: Spa treatments focus on recovery, such as deep-tissue massages and oxygen facials for high-altitude dehydration.
facts.excerpt: Treatments focus on recovery and include things like deep-tissue massages for tired quads and oxygen facials for high-altitude dehydration.

facts.text: The rooftop pool deck is heated year-round, with a hot tub facing the mountains.
facts.excerpt: the rooftop pool deck—heated year-round—with a hot tub facing the mountains

facts.text: Tavern on the Square is the hotel's main restaurant, opening directly onto Lionshead's main plaza.
facts.excerpt: Tavern on the Square is the hotel’s anchor restaurant, opening directly onto Lionshead’s main plaza

facts.text: The Gore Creek path runs just behind the plaza.
facts.excerpt: the Gore Creek path runs just behind the plaza

facts.text: A sky bridge connects the hotel's buildings, with views of the ice skating rink and the mountain.
facts.excerpt: check out the sky bridge connecting The Arrabelle’s buildings

facts.text: A courtesy shuttle takes guests to restaurants and bars.
facts.excerpt: There’s also a courtesy shuttle that makes it easy to reach restaurants and bars

facts.text: The concierge can arrange dinner reservations and private ski instructors; peak-season requests need advance notice.
facts.excerpt: The concierge can wrangle dinner reservations and arrange private ski instructors, though peak-season requests require advance notice.

facts.text: Plaza-facing rooms can catch noise during peak season; mountain-view rooms are recommended.
facts.excerpt: plaza-facing rooms are great for people-watching but can catch noise during peak season

facts.text: The hotel has elevators, accessible guest rooms and ADA-compliant public spaces.
facts.excerpt: The hotel has elevators, accessible guest rooms, and ADA-compliant public spaces.
